lines.text: David sought the LORD and was delivered from all his enemies, and the LORD heard the poor man who called out.

problems.problem: Its true detail "the LORD answered him" isn't in Psalm 34:4 word for word.
Its wrong detail "the king answered him" isn't found anywhere in the Bible.
Its true detail "the LORD answered him" isn't in the Prep cards, so the walkthrough didn't teach it.
